def _triangle_areas_fast(points):
    """Compute areas of all triangles formed by triples of points using vectorized operations."""
    n = len(points)

    # For all triples (i, j, k) with i < j < k
    areas = []
    for i in range(n):

                p1, p2, p3 = points[i], points[j], points[k]
